 About	
	
 
 
 
 
 
 Gulf Shores Steamer has been a local family owned restaurant since 1989. Originally located in Gulf Shores, Alabama the restaurant moved to it's current location, 27267 Perdido Beach Boulevard, Unit 115, Orange Beach, Alabama 36561 in 2010. Wonderful staff and location with a great view of SanRoc Cay Marina.
The Gulf Shores Steamer has been featured in magazines and daily newspapers, such as, Southern Living, Coastal Living, New Orleans Times Picayune, and many other noted periodicals. The Steamer continues to grow and thrive under the leadership of its owner, Jeff Price. The Steamer specializes in steamed and grilled seafood. The motto at The Steamer has always been "NO FRIED".
The Steamer serves delicious steamed Red Shrimp, Snow Crab Legs, Mussels and Oysters. We also have a great selection of grilled fish and for the "land lover", we serve delicious hand-cut steaks, grilled chicken, sandwiches and the "Island's Best Cheeseburger". Our specialty has always been combination platters that can feed two to four people and more. Come visit the Gulf Shores Steamer to see what all the critics rave about. It's casual family dining in a laid back coastal atmosphere.
We look forward to seeing you there!
Management & Staff
